496:t_1:89.en:
$$ミコット$$
「See you, $$バナージ$$. I'll leave the rest to you.」

496:t_1:91.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is this okay, $$オードリー$$...? Coming to a place like the hangar...」

496:t_1:94.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You still call me $$オードリー$$.」

496:t_1:96.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「It's all right. ...At least for now...」

496:t_1:98.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「While I'm here, I'm a member of $c, rather than the princess of $$ジオン$$.」

496:t_1:99.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But we can't stay like this...」

496:t_1:100.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Yes... To free the colonies taken over by $$サイデリアル$$, I must fulfill my responsibilities.」

496:t_1:101.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I believe your $$ユニコーン$$ will help me do that, too.」

496:t_1:103.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$バナージ$$... Traveling with $c, I've seen so many things.」

496:t_1:104.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I had knowledge, but I realized I only truly knew things after seeing, hearing, feeling and experiencing them. I hadn't known the world at all...」

496:t_1:105.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I feel the same. Our battles made me realize it.」

496:t_1:106.en:
$$バナージ$$
「People can get to know each other, but joining hands isn't so easy. Being unable to escape our origins and obligations is part of being human.」

496:t_1:107.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Space and Earth... Even if $$クロノ$$ intended it, people fought for their own positions...」

496:t_1:108.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But that man...$$カーディアス・ビスト$$ still wanted $$ラプラスの箱$$ opened, because he believed there was a future beyond it.」

496:t_1:109.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I want to believe in people's goodwill, too.」

496:t_1:111.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$バナージ$$... Thank you for protecting the $$ユニコーン$$...the key to $$ラプラスの箱$$, all this time.」

496:t_1:112.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$シャア$$ and I intend to entrust revealing the Box to you.」

496:t_1:114.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I don't know why $$フル・フロンタル$$ wants the Box in this world now...」

496:t_1:115.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Even if we obtain the Box before he does, I don't know what significance that will have.」

496:t_1:117.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let me say the rest, $$オードリー$$.」

496:t_1:119.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't know what the Box is either... They say it has the power to overturn the $$地球連邦$$, but honestly, I can't even imagine it...」

496:t_1:120.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...For a time, I intended to seal away the Box, since it causes conflict, so no one could touch it.」

496:t_1:121.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But then...I started to think that would be the same as running away.」

496:t_1:122.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...I feel the same way you do.」

496:t_1:123.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So I...intend to open $$ラプラスの箱$$ once we've freed Earth from $$サイデリアル$$.」

496:t_1:124.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Whatever it really is, I want to face it and think carefully about what to do...」

496:t_1:125.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I think I owe that to Dad, Lieutenant Colonel $$ダグザ$$, the people of $$ジオン$$...everyone who died over the Box.」

496:t_1:126.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I understand, $$バナージ$$. I respect your decision.」

496:t_1:128.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I'm counting on you to protect the $$ユニコーン$$ until that day comes.」

496:t_1:133.en: ～$$ラー・カイラム$$　$$アムロ・レイ$$'s Quarters～

496:t_1:134.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...It is unusual for you to visit my room.」

496:t_1:135.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's not as though I have a place within the team.」

496:t_1:136.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even self-mockery gets irritating if you take it too far.」

496:t_1:137.en:
$$シャア$$
「Such direct words help me reflect on myself.」

496:t_1:140.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I hear $$バナージ$$ told $$ミネバ$$ he intends to open the Box.」

496:t_1:142.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What do you think of $$ラプラスの箱$$?」

496:t_1:143.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$フロンタル$$ pursued it on his own authority. I was targeting $$クロノ$$, but I hadn't paid attention to that connection.」

496:t_1:144.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But with both $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ and $$ヴェーダ$$ silent, that must be our only key to uncovering $$クロノ$$'s true nature.」

496:t_1:145.en:
$$シャア$$
「I am also curious why $$フロンタル$$ is so obsessed with the Box.」

496:t_1:146.en:
$$シャア$$
「During the $$時獄戦役$$...I thought he was my body double, filled with the consciousness of myself from a parallel world.」

496:t_1:148.en:
$$シャア$$
「That was why I understood some of his thoughts. But...」

496:t_1:149.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're saying...you can't do that now?」

496:t_1:150.en:
$$シャア$$
「If he represents another possibility for me, I want to know his true intentions.」

496:t_1:154.en:
$$シャア$$
「They've discovered the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$'s position...!?」

496:t_1:155.en:
$$フェルト$$
「To all $c personnel. A force believed to be $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is approaching this sector.」

496:t_1:156.en:
$$フェルト$$
「All mobile unit personnel, prepare to sortie immediately.」

496:t_1:157.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is coming...!」

496:t_2:3.en: ～Deep-space $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$　Dock～

496:t_2:6.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$シャア$$ has gone, then...」

496:t_2:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But he hasn't betrayed us.」

496:t_2:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Depending on how things go, $$フロンタル$$ may execute $$シャア$$ and use him as a tool to incite the $$スペースノイド$$s.」

496:t_2:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then why did Colonel $$シャア$$...!?」

496:t_2:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「He probably intends to settle things with his shadow in his own way.」

496:t_2:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To do that, he's staked everything on $$フロンタル$$'s pride.」

496:t_2:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He believes that man will choose to face the Colonel...」
